title: Early drum sets: banjo-shell snare, rope bass drums, pedals and cymbals
summary: Details of the snare, bass drum ropes and pedals, tom-toms, Chinese cymbals and wood blocks used by early New Orleans drummers.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
